name: mcp-doctor
description: Diagnose, secure, and benchmark your MCP servers. Zero-config CLI that auto-discovers configs across Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop.
longDescription: MCP Doctor is a diagnostics CLI for MCP server configurations. It auto-discovers MCP configs across Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop, then lets you scan connections, audit for hardcoded secrets, and benchmark latency. Three tools: scan (discover and test MCP server connections), security (audit configs for hardcoded secrets and sensitive data), and bench (benchmark server startup and tool-call latency). Works out of the box with zero configuration required.
capabilities: Auto-discover MCP configs across Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop
Scan and test MCP server connections
Audit configs for hardcoded secrets and sensitive data
Benchmark server startup and tool-call latency

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Discover and test MCP server connections across all supported editors and clients

tools.name: security
tools.description: Audit MCP configurations for hardcoded secrets and sensitive data exposure

tools.name: bench
tools.description: Benchmark MCP server startup time and tool-call latency

features: Auto-discovery of MCP configurations across multiple editors
Interactive terminal UI with color output
